title: Why Do We Exist? The Spiritual Purpose of Human Life (1977-02-22)
description:
Feeling like life is meaningless or just a transition? Discover the evolutionary mechanism within you that connects you to the 'mains' and reveals your true purpose.

In this comprehensive talk, Shri Mataji details the subtle system, explaining how specific chakras relate to deities like Ganesha, Christ, and Krishna. She reveals the spiritual roots of physical ailments like diabetes, corrects misconceptions about fasting and celibacy, and explains the unity of all true religions as flowers on one tree.

Key Topics:
• ⚡ Human evolution and the mechanism of Kundalini that connects you to the "mains"
• 🌙 Mooladhara Chakra (Root Center) - why innocence and holiness are the foundation of growth
• 💭 Swadishthan Chakra (Sacral Center) - the spiritual link between overthinking, planning, and diabetes
• ❤️ The integration of religions: Understanding the relationship between Christ, Krishna, and Ganesha
• 💬 Dispelling myths about alcohol, mechanical rituals, and false gurus in modern spirituality

“A little drop wants to know the whole of the ocean! How can you explain to an ant the human civilization... and how can you explain to a human being the working of the subtle, divine forces.”
— Shri Mataji Nirmala Devi

Common Questions About Spiritual Awakening:
• What is the spiritual cause of diabetes and stress?
• How are Jesus and Krishna related spiritually?
• Why is alcohol bad for spiritual growth and chakras?

Shri Mataji describes human beings as being in 'transition' like an appliance waiting to be connected to the mains. Do you feel that potential within you waiting to awaken?
